enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Snore. Wake up. Open eyes. Stretch arms. Sit up on edge of bed. Plant feet on floor. Stand up.

enriched_activities.activity: Morning wash: shower, brush teeth, use toilet
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Lift toilet lid. Pull down pants. Sit on toilet. Urinate. Stand up. Pull up pants. Flush toilet. Walk to sink. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Pick up soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Walk to shower. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up shampoo. Pour shampoo into hand. Rub into scalp. Rinse hair. Pick up soap. Rub soap on body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry face. Dry body. Dry hair. Walk to sink. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wipe mouth with towel. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Prepare and eat breakfast using kettle and toaster
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place bread in toaster. Press lever. Open cupboard. Take out plate. Take out mug. Take out cereal box. Place bowl on counter. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Fill kettle with water. Place kettle on base. Press switch. Wait for kettle to boil. Toast pops up. Remove toast from toaster. Place on plate. Spread butter on toast. Pour hot water into mug. Add tea bag. Stir. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Eat toast. Drink tea. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Change into work clothes, check phone for shift messages, pack bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out work clothes. Take off pajamas. Put on work shirt. Put on work pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Press home button. Unlock phone. Open messaging app. Read messages. Close app. Place phone in pocket. Open bag. Place wallet in bag. Place keys in bag. Place water bottle in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone for bus time. Bus arrives. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Bus stops. Stand up. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Enter hospital. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working day shift as a health care professional: patient care, ward rounds, charting and handover
enriched_activities.desc: Receive handover from night shift. Read patient charts. Walk to patient room. Greet patient. Check vital signs. Measure blood pressure. Measure temperature. Administer medication. Adjust IV drip. Talk to patient. Walk to next patient. Assist with mobility. Change dressing. Walk to nurses' station. Write notes. Answer phone. Talk to doctor. Attend ward round. Discuss patient care. Walk to patient room. Perform procedure. Walk to supply room. Restock supplies. Walk to break room. Eat lunch. Return to ward. Continue patient care. Chart patient data. Prepare for handover. Give handover to evening shift. Walk to locker room. Change out of scrubs.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Sit down. Look at phone. Bus stops. Exit bus. Walk to house. Unlock door. Enter house. Close door. Lock door.

enriched_activities.activity: Wash up and change out of work clothes
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet hands. Apply soap. Rub hands. Rinse hands. Turn off tap. Dry hands. Walk to bedroom. Take off work clothes. Put on casual clothes. Walk back to bathroom. Pick up dirty clothes. Place in laundry basket. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Cook and eat dinner using oven and microwave (deliberately avoiding the induction cooker during the 5pm-8pm grid peak request)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out chicken. Close refrigerator. Place chicken on cutting board. Cut chicken. Season chicken. Place chicken in oven. Set oven temperature. Set timer. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Place vegetables in microwave-safe bowl. Put bowl in microwave. Set microwave timer. Start microwave. Wait. Take chicken out of oven. Take vegetables out of microwave. Place food on plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Stand up. Place dishes in sink. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Load the washing machine and start a laundry cycle
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Take out clothes. Place clothes in washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press start button. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Watch TV and relax on the sofa
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Turn on TV. Pick up remote. Sit on sofa. Press channel button. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Lean back. Put feet on coffee table. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Watch TV. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out drink. Close refrigerator. Walk back to living room. Sit on sofa. Drink. Watch TV. Put down drink. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Pick up shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse body. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel around body. Walk to bedroom. Put on pajamas. Walk back to bathroom. Hang towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Transfer laundry to the clothes dryer and start drying
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Open washing machine. Take out wet clothes. Place clothes in dryer. Close dryer door. Turn on dryer. Set timer. Press start. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Use the computer to check rosters and messages, then watch TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read messages. Open roster. Check shifts. Close computer. Stand up. Walk to sofa. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Watch TV. Change channel. Adjust volume. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Night routine: brush teeth and wash face
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Wash face with cleanser. Rinse face. Dry face with towel. Turn off light. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind down with phone, then sleep
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Lie on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open social media. Scroll. Read messages. Reply to messages. Close app. Place phone on bedside table. Turn off lamp. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to side. Adjust pillow. Remain still. Fall asleep.
